content.comment_body: Hello, I'm unable to connect to [product_name] [article_no]. I've selected the appropriate standard in the hardware menu and am using [product_name] [version_no]. When I try to connect, I get an error asking me to check: - [product_name] is in the correct mode - The PLC cable is connected - The correct interface is selected I've chosen the dedicated cable in the interface menu and have tried both RS232 and USB cables. I tested all COM ports and tried autodetection, but nothing works. I can't find a menu in [product_name] to select PC -> [product_name], but I read in another thread that the device automatically enters transfer mode, so it's not possible to select the menu manually. Any suggestions would be appreciated. Thanks in advance
Are you certain you've installed the drivers for your USB cable? Also, are you using Windows or another operating system?

Hello, Which operating system are you using? Do you have a physical COM port or a USB-to-serial converter? Are the necessary drivers installed? Please check your COM port settings: - Baud rate: 9600 - Data bits: 8 - Parity: None - Stop bits: 1 - Flow control: None - FIFO buffer: Use receive and transfer buffer high Regards, [user_name]
Hi, Try switching to [article_no] [version_no] and test again. There has been a new firmware release recently, which requires you to select it in [product_name] [version_no]. Regards

Hi again, Today I tried downloading the project again, and it worked. I'm not sure what changed, as I didn't modify the program or connections. The only difference is that my computer was restarted, and by accident I selected an old project to download, which succeeded. After realizing the mistake, I tried downloading the correct project and it also worked. Now I can download to [product_name] every time. I'm using the USB cable. Thanks very much for your responses. I appreciate everyone taking the time to help.

analysis.insight_summary: Users experienced challenges connecting the programming software to the hardware module, exploring multiple troubleshooting options including checking cables and COM port configuration. Initial efforts were unsuccessful and led to frustration. Ultimately, the issue was resolved after rebooting the computer and downloading a different project, though the exact cause remains unclear.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect a simple and reliable connection process between the software and hardware module, along with clear troubleshooting instructions and prompt error feedback.
